fishing: WHEN: Tuesday evening Oct 6. Boca Grande falling to low 4:51p (0.4 ft), then incoming to high 11:39p (1.4 ft). Lemon Bay sunset about 7:10p. Evening window about 5:40p-7:40p; Wednesday looks better on the dawn move (about 6:38a-8:38a). Light SW, small seas, showers possible. Snook harvest open in Charlotte Harbor / SW through Nov 30 (slot 28-33, 1/day). PASSES-BEACH: Fishin Franks 10/2 beach trough edges holding redfish and snook, with ladyfish, bluefish and trout mixed in; mornings and evenings still the better light. LEMON BAY: 10/2 docks and mangroves holding mangrove snapper, small black drum, redfish and snook; a few trout on the grass. NEARSHORE: West Wall south half lots of redfish, snook picked up after the weak front (treeline, deeper cuts). Placida mangrove snapper fewer but bigger; a few sharks near Gasparilla Pass. Florida Sportsman SW Oct 1-5: redfish schools mostly 24-30 in, snook and trout on the last hour of the tide; nearshore bigger snook on threadfin and pilchards, wrecks holding snapper, jacks, small grouper and an occasional cobia. Capt. Mike / Manasota Key Outfitters last posted report is June (summer tarpon); no October bite note. Baits: live shrimp, cut bait, pinfish, gold spoons, topwater.
redtide: FWC Oct 2: K. brevis background only in SWFL (Sarasota samples); no fish kills or respiratory irritation. Next report Oct 9.
bacteria: Manasota Key Beach GOOD, no advisory — enterococci 10 on 9/28 (Healthy Beaches, page updated 10/6). Englewood Beach GOOD, last listed 20 CFU on 9/21, no advisory.
fpl: Evening check: Charlotte 2 / Sarasota 149 customers out; no Englewood/Manasota spike noted.
